id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting transient app store connect 5xx 429 as unhandled errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Apple App Store Connect API to the list of transient, self-recovering errors, allowing ingestion activity to be retried by Temporal rather than failing immediately.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 adds documentation and tests for handling 429 and 5xx errors as retryable for Apple App Store Connect API. While the actual implementation and the `retryable_errors` set are not present in this chunk, the documentation and tests establish the intended behavior and scope of the change. This supports a Tier 1 score as it represents a bounded, localized maintenance/
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation or the `retryable_errors` set, so the score relies on documentation and tests rather than executable behavior. The tier is assigned based on the documented intent and test coverage, not the runtime implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new error classification or the corresponding retryable_errors set, only the documentation and tests. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation and tests added for handling 429 and 5xx errors as retryable, while retaining the original HTTPSConnectionPool error.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds Apple App Store Connect API to the list of transient, self-recovering errors, allowing the ingestion activity to be retried by Temporal rather than failing immediately. This could prevent ingestion failures due to temporary rate limiting or server-side errors.
